confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge and the supplied comparables, not checked against live listings. Coffee and restaurant anchors are more reliable; hotel and drink anchors are less certain given Mumbai's wide price range and Indian alcohol taxation. Cocktail and wine are set at about twice the draught beer anchor and cross-checked against typical bar price bands. FX rate taken from the RBA exchange-rates page as surfaced by web search; the F11.1 table itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated against the supplied mid-2026 Kathmandu, Colombo and Manila figures: draught beer sits near Kathmandu and above Colombo; coffee tracks Colombo and Manila; inexpensive meals fall between Kathmandu and Colombo; mid-range two-person meals sit above all three comparables; dorm beds track Colombo and Manila; private hostel and three-star rooms fall between Manila and Colombo; basic hotel rooms fall between Kathmandu and Manila.
